applicant.organisation: Austrian Federal Ministry, consumer protection department

purpose: We are studying whether private insurers charge people with diabetes higher premiums, to prepare consumer protection rules. We need regional prevalence as background.
question: How many adults have type 2 diabetes, per region?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Type 2 diabetes = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E11.
Report per region: adults with type 2 diabetes.
